the active version only when the Student has no active Resume.

AccountDeletion.title: AccountDeletion
AccountDeletion.description:
Confirms an account deletion: the account's email, typed by the Student. Compared
after trimming and ignoring case.

file.title: File
file.description: A PDF, DOCX or plain-text file of 5 MB or less

file.title: File
file.description: A PDF or DOCX file of 5 MB or less

ConsentGrant.title: ConsentGrant
ConsentGrant.description: The version of the text the Student was shown and agreed to.

ConsentPurpose.title: ConsentPurpose
ConsentPurpose.description:
Phase 1 purposes. Phase 2 adds ``linkedin_link``, ``outreach`` and ``llm_drafting``
(with a migration widening ``consents_purpose_check``).

ConsentStatus.title: ConsentStatus
ConsentStatus.description:
One purpose: the text to show (plain-text paragraphs) and the Student's status on it.

``status``: ``granted`` (active on the current version), ``outdated`` (active on an older
version: agree again), ``revoked`` (withdrawn) or ``none`` (never agreed).

DocumentDownload.title: DocumentDownload
DocumentDownload.description:
A signed URL that downloads the file as an attachment; it stops working at
``expires_at`` (5 minutes or less).

DocumentList.title: DocumentList
DocumentList.description: Newest first. Pass ``next_cursor`` as ``cursor`` to get the next page (null = done).

DocumentOut.title: DocumentOut
DocumentOut.description: One stored Document. ``filename`` is untrusted text: render it as plain text.

Me.title: Me
Me.description: The calling account. ``role`` comes from the database, never from the token.

PreferencesIn.title: PreferencesIn
PreferencesIn.description:
The whole Preferences object (a full replace; every field is required, nullable ones
may be null). Role titles and locations are trimmed, blanks dropped and duplicates
(ignoring case) dropped; at most 10 of 80 characters each.

PreferencesOut.title: PreferencesOut
PreferencesOut.description:
The stored Preferences, or the defaults with ``saved: false`` before the first save.
``role_titles``, ``locations`` and ``degree_other`` are untrusted text: render them as
plain text.

ProfileSkill.title: ProfileSkill
ProfileSkill.description:
An effective skill. ``source`` is ``extracted`` when the active Resume mentions it,
else ``added`` (the Student added it).

ResumeDownload.title: ResumeDownload
ResumeDownload.description:
A signed URL that downloads the file as an attachment; it stops working at
``expires_at`` (5 minutes or less).

ResumeList.title: ResumeList
ResumeList.description: Newest first. Pass ``next_cursor`` as ``cursor`` to get the next page (null = done).

ResumeVersion.title: ResumeVersion
ResumeVersion.description: One uploaded Resume version. ``filename`` is untrusted text: render it as plain text.

RightsNotice.title: RightsNotice
RightsNotice.description: The India DPDP Act rights notice, shown with the consent texts (plain text).

SkillProfileEdit.title: SkillProfileEdit
SkillProfileEdit.description:
``add``: terms (a vocabulary match becomes a skill, anything else a custom skill);
``remove``: skill ids; ``remove_custom``: custom terms.

SkillProfileOut.title: SkillProfileOut
SkillProfileOut.description:
The Student's Skill Profile. ``status`` is ``none`` before any Resume was extracted.
``message`` is set when the Resume could not be read. ``custom``, ``education`` and
``experience`` are untrusted text: render them as plain text. ``resume_id`` is null when
the source Resume was deleted (the profile is kept).
